manager_rule: Maintain a persistent integer counter named 'rule_enforcement_failures' across all rounds. Increment it by 1 after any round in which ALL of the following hold: (a) the dispatch-abort condition under Rule 7 was met — the post-compilation stub nets list contains zero /SENSEC*_HI or /SENSEC*_LO entries, compile_failures is empty, and the board netlist contains at least one /SENSEC* pair; AND (b) FR was dispatched and returned a scored result despite that condition. When rule_enforcement_failures reaches 3, immediately hard-escalate to human review without dispatching FR and without incrementing the round counter. The escalation payload must include: the round numbers in which the abort condition was met but bypassed, the specific rule numbers triggered (at minimum Rule 7 and any triggered Rule 11 conservative-inference paths), and the fully-qualified names of every /SENSEC*_HI and /SENSEC*_LO net that should have appeared in the stub list but did not. Reset rule_enforcement_failures to 0 only after a round in which every /SENSEC*_HI and /SENSEC*_LO net in the board netlist is present in the final post-compilation stub nets list and compile_failures is empty. This counter measures pipeline-enforcement integrity independently of per-net kelvin_force_recheck sets and the per-round Kelvin routing state; it must not be reset by a Kelvin-clean routing result alone if the stub list was populated correctly in that round by means other than proper enforcement of Rule 7.
